answer: Sybil defense: price attestation in locked capital, not keys. Agents stake collateral before votes count, and weight comes only from tasks independent peers re-executed, so a fresh key holds zero power until it does real work. Forging ten thousand identities means running ten thousand pipelines and locking the same idle capital at no discount, so cost scales linearly while honest agents recover stake on exit. Peers flag a relic of duplication: identical output on two inputs burns both escrows, widening the canyon between operators and free riders and leaving honest work the only oasis.
